decisions: Is the buyer asking for retail boxes, shipping mailers, rigid gift boxes, cosmetic boxes, paper tubes, clear boxes or paper bags?
Can the buyer provide product size, packed weight, quantity range, material direction and artwork status?
Does the box need an insert, window, sleeve, magnetic closure, hanger, tray or shipping protection?
Is the buyer comparing visual packaging, structural packaging or complete product packaging support?
Which destination-market claims or documents must remain buyer-confirmed before any compliance statement is made?
